schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE `atom` (
  `atom_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `molecule_id` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `element` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`atom_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`molecule_id`) REFERENCES `molecule` (`molecule_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `bond` (
  `bond_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `molecule_id` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `bond_type` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`bond_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`molecule_id`) REFERENCES `molecule` (`molecule_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `connected` (
  `atom_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `atom_id2` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `bond_id` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`atom_id`,`atom_id2`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`atom_id`) REFERENCES `atom` (`atom_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`atom_id2`) REFERENCES `atom` (`atom_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`bond_id`) REFERENCES `bond` (`bond_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE `molecule` (
  `molecule_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `label` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`molecule_id`)
);
q1: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, -2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND T2.label = '+'
q2: SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE SUBSTRING(atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN 21 AND 25)

q2_prompt_sql: SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE SUBSTRING(atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN 21 AND 25)

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 uses DISTINCT to remove duplicates, while Q2 does not. This can lead to different results if the same molecule_id appears more than once in the result set of the subquery in Q2.
